acceptanceCriteria: A Git process that hangs while the repository is opened produces `INVALID` with gap `git-timeout`, not `invalid-repository`, covered by a test with a fake hanging git.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). Review of PR #78 (V1-0008): GENESIS-025 names `git-timeout` for hangs after open; a hang during open is misreported.
title: genesis: a Git hang during repository open yields `invalid-repository` instead of `git-timeout`
